entities.name: Network slicing indication
entities.description: Information element that indicates when a requested NSSAI is created from the default configured NSSAI.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Registration request message sent by the UE during registration procedure.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice selection assistance information requested by the UE.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI created from default configured NSSAI
entities.description: Condition where the requested NSSAI is derived from the default configured NSSAI.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the requested NSSAI information element.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the network slicing indication IE when the condition is met.
Presence of network slicing indication IE is guarded by the condition that requested NSSAI is created from default configured NSSAI.
